name: scdaw_process_audio_clip
description: Apply PCM DSP effects (peak normalize, amplify, EBU R128 loudness, DC offset removal, invert, reverse, click/pop removal, fade bake) or generate synthesized audio clips (tone/chirp, white/pink/brownian noise, DTMF, silence) with lossless undo.

effect.description: DSP processor or audio generator to execute

clipId.description: Target audio clip ID (required for processing effects)

startSec.description: Optional sub-range start time in seconds within clip buffer

endSec.description: Optional sub-range end time in seconds within clip buffer

time.description: Start beat position for generated clips (default 0)

name.description: Optional clip name for generated clips

params.description: Effect/generator options (e.g. targetDb, gainDb, targetLufs, threshold, waveform, frequency, endFrequency, type, sequence, durationSec)
